# Hilltop Workshop — Equipment Care Notes

Fictional development evaluation material. This is not a real organization policy.

## Lubrication
Hilltop conveyor bearings are lubricated every 70 operating hours. In a dusty bay, the lubrication interval is 35 operating hours. The inspection interval remains 14 days.
Operational note: This section concerns lubrication. Read the written instruction in its original context. Keep the original file available for review. This section concerns lubrication. Read the written instruction in its original context. Keep the original file available for review. 

## Calibration
Hilltop pressure sensors are calibrated every 28 days. Following a sensor replacement, calibration is required before restarting the machine.
Operational note: This section concerns calibration. Read the written instruction in its original context. Keep the original file available for review. This section concerns calibration. Read the written instruction in its original context. Keep the original file available for review. 

## Lockout
Before clearing a Hilltop conveyor jam, the technician must isolate electrical power and attach a lockout tag.
Operational note: This section concerns lockout. Read the written instruction in its original context. Keep the original file available for review. This section concerns lockout. Read the written instruction in its original context. Keep the original file available for review. 

## Spare parts
Hilltop replacement belts must be checked by the Maintenance Lead before installation.
Operational note: This section concerns spare parts. Read the written instruction in its original context. Keep the original file available for review. This section concerns spare parts. Read the written instruction in its original context. Keep the original file available for review. 

## Records
Hilltop service records are retained for 18 months. Records involved in an unresolved warranty dispute are kept until the dispute closes.
Operational note: This section concerns records. Read the written instruction in its original context. Keep the original file available for review. This section concerns records. Read the written instruction in its original context. Keep the original file available for review. 

## Restart packet
The Hilltop restart packet contains a lockout record, calibration log and signed maintenance release.
Operational note: This section concerns restart packet. Read the written instruction in its original context. Keep the original file available for review. This section concerns restart packet. Read the written instruction in its original context. Keep the original file available for review. 

## Leak response
A Hilltop coolant leak requires the technician to stop the pump and notify the Maintenance Lead immediately.
Operational note: This section concerns leak response. Read the written instruction in its original context. Keep the original file available for review. This section concerns leak response. Read the written instruction in its original context. Keep the original file available for review. 

## Battery charging
Hilltop battery packs are charged in the ventilated charging bay. Damaged battery packs must not be charged.
Operational note: This section concerns battery charging. Read the written instruction in its original context. Keep the original file available for review. This section concerns battery charging. Read the written instruction in its original context. Keep the original file available for review.
